title: Could you explain the underlying logic of the Profile Helper in AAPS?
body:
Hello AAPS team,

I’ve examined the Profile Helper function that generates configuration profiles based on age and weight (e.g., in DefaultProfile.kt). Each age group appears to have predefined parameters (e.g., ISF, basal rates, carb ratios).

Could you clarify:

1. **Source of these age/weight-based parameters**: Are they derived from clinical studies, consensus guidelines (e.g., ADA, ISPAD), or empirical data?
2. **Literature references**: If research-backed, could you share relevant publications or methodologies used to define these values?

This would help users (and contributors like myself) understand the physiological rationale behind the defaults.

Thanks for your work on this project!

comments.body:
These are values used in hospitals in Europe.
DPV is version from Germany
